api/zgock.ShapeSync.Editor.html.summary: Namespace zgock.ShapeSync.Editor Classes BindposeTestMeshGeneratorWindow Generates diagnostic meshes for bindpose validation workflows. BlendShapeBakeUtility Provides editor-only utilities for baking and inspecting BlendShape data. BonePoseUtility Captures and applies serialized local bone pose data in editor workflows. DynamicBoneBlendTargetDrawer Draws a serialized dynamic bone BlendShape target in the Inspector. EditModeAtlasBakerPageExecutor EditMode Atlas page executor. It deliberately lowers one Core page into one Texture recipe; thus EditMode selects partition count one without making that choice part of the Core contract. EditModeMeshBuildResult Single-take final Mesh handoff. It owns the complete compiler escrow until the upper Compiler either transfers the in-memory result to its next phase or disposes it on abort / cancel. EditModeMeshPayloadBuilder Maps TSM-owned Normal completions onto Core-resolved Material slots. ExternalTransferWindow Transfers compatible ShapeSync data from an external source asset. FbmBodyPrefabWindow Exports an FBM body prefab from a selected ShapeSync Figure. HumanoidCompilerWindow Editor UI that drives one caller-owned Pure Humanoid build and publishes only after build success. HumanoidPublishPathValidator Validates Editor publish paths without creating assets or folders. HumanoidPureHumanoidComponentStripper Normalizes the unpublished output clone into a Pure Humanoid before publish work begins. HumanoidVrmTransportExecutorProvider Editor-assembly registration seam for the optional UniVRM executor. The main Editor UI asks this provider only when VRM transport is selected; VrmIntegration.Editor registers the concrete implementation on domain load. MeshUtilityWindow Provides ShapeSync mesh merge, separation, and diagnostic editor workflows. NormalMapBakeWindow Bakes an editor-only tangent-space normal-map test texture from one submesh's area-weighted geometric normals. OutfitAttacherEditor Custom Inspector for configuring an OutfitAttacher. ProfileControlledMorphProjection Projects Profile Controlled Morph deformation data in editor tooling. ShapeSyncDatabaseAsset Typed asset access for the root component of a ShapeSync Database Prefab. ShapeSyncDatabaseCanonicalAssetResolver Resolves the already-admitted Figure / Mesh Outfit Base owner used by an optional integration. This is an Editor-only bridge over Core authoring data; it does not inspect asset names or search the AssetDatabase. ShapeSyncDatabaseOptionalRegistryProvider Optional Database admission seam. The core Editor assembly owns the seam; an optional integration registers the concrete validator without creating a reverse assembly reference. ShapeSyncDatabaseOptionalUiProvider Optional Database UI seam. Core owns the callbacks so the Database window can remain UniVRM-free; an optional integration supplies its own rows and persistence behavior after domain reload. ShapeSyncDatabaseTransaction Performs authoring structural changes through Prefab contents rather than Undo. ShapeSyncDatabaseTransaction.EditContext Provides controlled sub-asset operations during one Database transaction. ShapeSyncDatabaseValidator Non-mutating whole-Database validator for declared authoring relations. It reports every localized defect in deterministic order and never performs Generate. ShapeSyncDatabaseWindow Provides the authoring-only shell for the ShapeSync Database editor. ShapeSyncFigureImport Admission boundary for a persistent Humanoid source; it never clones, merges, or edits assets. ShapeSyncFigureImportAdmission Validated, source-only facts accepted by the Figure import admission boundary. ShapeSyncFigureMeshMerger Editor-only boundary that reuses Mesh Utility's exact skinned-mesh merge implementation. ShapeSyncFigureMeshMerger.Result Owns an unsaved merged clone and its in-memory Mesh until transferred or disposed. SkinnedMeshMergerWindow Merges compatible skinned meshes for ShapeSync authoring workflows. SkinnedMeshSeparatorWindow Separates selected geometry from a skinned mesh into a new asset. SkinningDiagnosticsWindow Inspects skinning, bindpose, and bone mapping diagnostics. SurfaceProjectorWindow Projects source surface data onto a compatible target mesh. TextureCompletion Owns one in-memory linear RGBAHalf completion until its receiver disposes it. TextureEditModeStackMachine Editor-only, caller-driven concrete executor for a shared TextureExecutionPlan. This class owns only its submitted dispatch and temporary GPU textures. It does not publish assets, perform GPU readback, register an Editor update callback, or own compiler rollback. UniversalExpressionProxyEditor Custom Inspector for configuring a UniversalExpressionProxy. Structs EditModeMeshNormalPayload One Mesh-semantic Normal completion keyed by the Core MaterialId. ProfileControlledMorphProjection.Result Immutable output metrics and vertex deltas from a surface projection operation. ProfileControlledMorphProjection.Settings Immutable parameters controlling one surface projection operation. Interfaces IHumanoidVrmTransportExecutor Optional UniVRM Editor-assembly seam. The main ShapeSync Editor assembly never references UniVRM types. Enums TextureEditModeExecutionStatus Represents the terminal state of one caller-driven EditMode Texture execution. Delegates ShapeSyncDatabaseOptionalRegistryProvider.VrmGenerateDelegate Core-safe Generate callback supplied by an optional integration. ShapeSyncDatabaseOptionalRegistryProvider.VrmGenerateFinalizeDelegate Core-safe final Generate callback supplied by an optional integration.

Returns bool true when the Proxy accepted the plan, including a partial semantic application; otherwise, false. Remarks Ownership of non-null candidate deliveries transfers at invocation. TryDryRun(string, MaterialProxySemanticValues, out MaterialAttacherDryRunPlan, out MaterialProxyDiagnostic) Validates a co-located Proxy request without receiving deliveries or changing Material state. public bool TryDryRun(string entryName, MaterialProxySemanticValues values, out MaterialAttacherDryRunPlan plan, out MaterialProxyDiagnostic diagnostic) Parameters entryName string The Proxy entry to update. values MaterialProxySemanticValues The semantic values to validate. plan MaterialAttacherDryRunPlan The transient plan to pass unchanged to TryCommit(MaterialAttacherDryRunPlan, TextureDelivery, out MaterialAttacherResult). diagnostic MaterialProxyDiagnostic The warning or hard failure diagnostic. Returns bool true when a plan was created; otherwise, false. Remarks The caller temporarily retains plan and passes it to TryCommit(MaterialAttacherDryRunPlan, TextureDelivery, out MaterialAttacherResult) or discards it. The Attacher does not retain the plan. Returns bool true when a reset plan was created. TryRestore(string, out MaterialAttacherResult) Relays restoration of one Proxy entry. public bool TryRestore(string entryName, out MaterialAttacherResult result) Parameters entryName string The Proxy entry to restore. result MaterialAttacherResult The restore outcome and any Proxy diagnostic. api/zgock.ShapeSync.Materials.MaterialAt.summary: Enum MaterialAttacherResultCode Namespace zgock.ShapeSync.Materials Assembly zgock.ShapeSync.Runtime.dll Identifies the overall outcome of one MaterialAttacher operation. public enum MaterialAttacherResultCode Fields Applied = 0 The requested semantics were applied or restored. EntryBusy = 3 The entry was already applying to its Material Proxy and the request was rejected. PartialApplied = 1 The operation succeeded, but one or more requested semantics were unsupported and ignored. Rejected = 2 The request was rejected and its received delivery candidates were released. RestoreFailed = 4 The Proxy entry could not be restored, so its current deliveries remain owned by the Attacher. Remarks PartialApplied reports a successful commit in which an unsupported semantic was ignored.

zgock.ShapeSync.Materials.NormalBlender.entries is the complete authoring surface: each element is one Proxy entry name. The Blender resolves the co-located Proxy and Mesh StackMachine once, then privately owns per-entry request, stale/cancel, and delivery lifecycle. Disable suspends valid delivery escrow without dispatching; enable synchronously reapplies matching escrow or queues ordinary re-derivation for a changed snapshot. It never uses MaterialAttacher. api/zgock.ShapeSync.ShapeSyncDatabaseDia.summary: Enum ShapeSyncDatabaseDiagnosticCode Namespace zgock.ShapeSync Assembly zgock.ShapeSync.Runtime.dll Stable authoring validation code emitted by the Database validator. public enum ShapeSyncDatabaseDiagnosticCode Fields DatabaseRequired = 1 The supplied Database root is missing or invalid. EntityCardinality = 8 An entity count violates a required cardinality. EntityDuplicate = 4 More than one entity claims an identity that must be unique. EntityInvalid = 3 A Database-owned entity is structurally invalid. None = 0 No diagnostic was emitted. OptionalFeatureUnavailable = 9 An optional Database feature cannot be safely opened in this build. RegistryRequired = 2 The Database registry is missing or invalid. RelationAmbiguous = 7 A relation resolves to more than one target. RelationMissing = 5 A required relation is absent. RelationTargetMissing = 6 A relation names a target that does not exist.

api/zgock.ShapeSync.html.summary: Namespace zgock.ShapeSync Classes AttachedOutfitRegistrySet Runtime record for one attached Outfit and the registry identity used to detach or replace it. BlendShapeReservedPrefixes Defines the reserved BlendShape name prefixes shared by ShapeSync Runtime, Editor, VRM Integration, and tests. BonePoseData Serialized local-pose and optional bindpose data for one named skeleton bone. CharacterBoneRegistry stores these records for Figure and Outfit authoring. CharacterBoneRegistry Immutable authoring data that maps an FBM target to its bone poses and bindposes. Runtime consumers use the recorded poses; they do not derive behavior from the optional name metadata. ColorEntry One proxy-wide Material color contribution. DynamicBoneBlendTarget Serializable FBM or PBM target definition used by DynamicBoneBlender. It associates a BlendShape name with the Avatar and bone registry required to apply its skeletal state. DynamicBoneBlender Figure runtime controller that applies FBM/PBM weights to mesh BlendShapes, bindposes, Avatar, and bone pose data. DynamicBonePbmDifferenceTarget Absolute FBM-plus-PBM skeletal target owned by one PBM entry. DynamicMorphAdapter Runtime owner for Plugable PCM slot allocation and payload mesh replacement on a Figure renderer. DynamicMorphAdapter.PreparedPcmAttach Prepared, uncommitted PCM attachment state used to preserve transactional attach semantics. DynamicMorphAdapter.SlotSchema Serialized layout of reserved PCM slots and the normal FBM names that index each slot group. FigureMorphSyncCoordinator Owns the fixed post-PCM-mesh-replacement write order for a Figure. BlendShape indices are invariant, so this coordinator only reapplies cached values; it never asks DDB or UEP to rebuild their caches. HairShape Runtime shape that contributes hair entries. HairShapeTemplate Authoring source for a runtime Hair shape. HumanoidBoneCorrectionProfileApplicator Applies a BC Profile to an Editor-owned humanoid rig for static authoring. MaterialEntry Base physical contribution addressed to a Material StackMachine proxy entry. MeshEntry Physical Mesh attach or detach contribution. MeshGeometrySignature Computes the authoring-time geometry signature used to verify that a PCM payload matches its Figure mesh. MeshMaskEntry One Figure Material Proxy mask owned by a MeshEntry. MorphShape Runtime shape that requests FBM morph values. MorphShapeTemplate Authoring source for a runtime Morph shape. OutfitAttacher Figure-side runtime component that attaches, detaches, and keeps Outfit renderers synchronized with FBM changes. OutfitShape Runtime shape that contributes outfit entries. OutfitShapeTemplate Authoring source for a runtime Outfit shape. OutfitSkinnedMeshBinding Runtime-owned binding that clones and updates one attached Outfit renderer's mesh and bindposes. OutfitSkinningFbmBindposes Bindpose set for one normal FBM variant of an Outfit renderer. PBM targets are represented by their owning Outfit data rather than this list. OutfitSkinningProfile Authoring profile used to align an attached Outfit renderer to the Figure skinning space. It records base and normal-FBM bindposes without changing the source Outfit mesh at runtime. OutfitSkinningRendererProfile Skinning data for one renderer under an Outfit root, addressed by its relative transform path. PartsShape Base runtime shape for skin, hair, and outfit parts. ProfileControlledMorphAsset Serialized Plugable PCM payload for one Outfit, containing the base and normal-FBM correction frames. The payload is owned by the optional attachment workflow and does not require UniVRM. ProfileControlledMorphBinding Transactional runtime binding between an Outfit PCM payload and a Figure renderer or DynamicMorphAdapter. Use the factory methods and commit/rollback lifecycle instead of constructing bindings directly. SerializedHairShape Serialized value record for one runtime Hair shape. SerializedMorphShape Serialized value record for one runtime Morph shape. SerializedOutfitShape Serialized value record for one runtime Outfit shape. SerializedPartsShape Common serialized value record for one runtime parts-based Shape. SerializedSkinShape Serialized value record for one runtime Skin shape. ShapeDeserializer Component base for deserializers owned by the Figure hosting ShapeDirector. ShapeDirector Owns logical runtime Shapes and dispatches compiled Figure transactions to co-located StackMachines. ShapeDocument ScriptableObject carrier for serialized Shape Director state and recovery recipes. ShapeDocumentDeserializer Standard Figure component that deserializes runtime Shapes from a ShapeDocument carrier. ShapeDocumentSerializer Standard Figure component that serializes runtime Shapes into a ShapeDocument carrier. ShapeEntry Base class for a physical contribution made by a parts-based shape. ShapeSerializer Component base for serializers owned by the Figure hosting ShapeDirector. ShapeSyncAnimatorResolver Resolves the Animator that drives a ShapeSync runtime component from its own hierarchy. ShapeSyncDatabase Authoring-only root component for one ShapeSync Database Prefab. Generated runtime Figures must not retain this component. ShapeSyncDatabaseDiagnostic Structured, authoring-only Database diagnostic. It is deliberately independent of UnityEditor so the same admission seam can be used by Registry and Editor validation. ShapeSyncDatabaseOptionalFeatureMarker Database-local marker for an optional authoring feature. The marker deliberately contains no optional-package type. It remains loadable when the package that owns the feature is absent, allowing the Database admission layer to reject a destructive open before Unity has a chance to round-trip the missing scripts. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry Authoring-only Database sub-asset containing Figure, Outfit, Material, Texture, Normal, and Shape declarations. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.BaseFigureEntry Identifies the canonical Base Figure stored by a Database. ShapeSyncEntryMerge Directly partitions resolved physical Shapes into Mesh and Material compiler inputs. ShapeSyncFigureImportRecord Authoring-only serialized carrier for one imported intermediate Humanoid; it has no runtime behaviour. ShapeSyncHumanoidBoneCorrection Local Humanoid transform correction for one bone, expressed as position, rotation, and scale deltas. ShapeSyncHumanoidBoneCorrectionProfile Reusable authoring asset that describes the Humanoid pose correction required by an Outfit. Builders consume it when baking target meshes and Outfit bindposes. ShapeSyncMaterialRecipeCompiler Builds detached Material StackMachine source from sorted Material entries. ShapeSyncMergedEntry Compiler-local context retained for one physical Shape entry. ShapeSyncMeshRecipeCompiler Builds a detached Mesh StackMachine source from current and desired physical Shapes. ShapeSyncOptionalVrmIntegrationRegistry Per-Figure registry that lets Core discover an optional VRM companion without a direct assembly reference. ShapeSyncOutfit Serialized Outfit descriptor consumed by OutfitAttacher. It owns registry identity, skinning data, BC Profiles, and optional Plugable PCM metadata. ShapeSyncOutfitFbmExtraBoneRegistry Maps one normal FBM name to the Outfit extra-bone registry required for that variant. ShapeSyncOutfitFbmHumanoidBoneCorrectionProfile Maps one normal FBM name to its optional Humanoid bone correction profile. ShapeSyncPhysicsRootMetadata Non-blocking provenance data used to correlate Physics transfers. ShapeSyncShape Runtime logical shape selected by a Shape Director. ShapeSyncShapeResolver Pure exclusion resolver that converts requested runtime Shapes into physical composition order. ShapeSyncShapeTemplate ScriptableObject authoring source for one Shape Director runtime shape. SkinShape Runtime shape that contributes skin entries. SkinShapeTemplate Authoring source for a runtime Skin shape. TextureEntry One Texture source-over contribution and optional mask/colorization data. UniversalExpressionEntry Serialized Figure expression entry that drives one BlendShape and optional MCM bindings. UniversalExpressionProxy Figure runtime component that applies authored expressions and forwards logical expression values to optional VRM integration. UvsetEntry One proxy-wide Material UV transform contribution. Structs ExpressionMcmBinding Runtime-resolved binding between one expression and one MCM BlendShape. FbmWeightChange Immutable FBM weight notification emitted by DynamicBoneBlender. MorphValue One logical morph target and its requested value. OutfitAttacherDryRunCommand One side-effect-free Outfit operation submitted to TryDryRun(IReadOnlyList<OutfitAttacherDryRunCommand>, out OutfitAttacherDryRunResult). OutfitAttacherDryRunResult Structured outcome of a side-effect-free Outfit operation dry-run. ShapeSyncOptionalVrmAttachRequest Core-only data supplied to an optional VRM physics attachment operation. It deliberately exposes no UniVRM types. ShapeSyncOptionalVrmDryRunRequest Core-only read-only request for optional VRM Outfit capability validation. Interfaces IShapeDeserializer Deserializes an implementation-defined file name into a runtime Shape list. IShapeDocumentSourceDeserializer Optional capability for decoding a standard in-memory ShapeDocument source. IShapeSerializer Serializes a runtime Shape list to an implementation-defined file name. IShapeSyncOptionalVrmAttachment Optional VRM attachment lifecycle used by the Core without referencing UniVRM types. The companion integration owns the implementation so Core remains independently compilable. IShapeSyncOptionalVrmIntegration Core-facing optional VRM integration contract implemented only by the UniVRM companion assembly. IShapeSyncOptionalVrmIntegrationDryRun Optional read-only VRM capability check used by transactional Outfit dry-runs. Enums ShapeSyncDatabaseDiagnosticCode Stable authoring validation code emitted by the Database validator. ShapeSyncDatabaseEntityKind Identifies the Database-owned entity at which an authoring diagnostic is localized. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.FigureAxisKind Classifies one Figure deformation axis without changing its canonical name. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.OutfitCollectionKind One Mesh Outfit's unified authoring declaration for BCP and PCM input. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.OutfitKind Classifies an authoring-only Outfit entity. Mesh and Material outfits share identity rules but not payload. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.OutfitMaterialClassification Classifies one source Material for a Mesh Outfit. Only Include later creates logical resources. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.ShapeEntryKind Classifies an ordered authoring entry in a parts-based Shape. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.ShapeKind Classifies a concrete Shape authoring record without changing the Spec16 runtime schema. ShapeSyncDatabaseRegistry.TextureResourceOwnerScope Classifies the authoring source which owns a Texture resource aggregation group. ShapeSyncDatabaseRelationKind Identifies the declared relation that is invalid or incomplete.
